article.headline: Johnson's 19 lead South Carolina State past Maryland Eastern Shore 63-54
article.description: — Jayden Johnson scored 19 points as South Carolina State beat Maryland Eastern Shore 63-54 on Wednesday night.
article.linkText: Johnson's 19 lead South Carolina State past Maryland Eastern Shore 63-54

categories.description: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

event.description: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

keywords: Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks @ South Carolina State Bulldogs
article.story: ORANGEBURG, S.C. -- — Jayden Johnson scored 19 points as South Carolina State beat Maryland Eastern Shore 63-54 on Wednesday night. Johnson also had six rebounds for the Bulldogs (6-16, 4-2 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). James Morrow shot 5 of 7 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to add 14 points. Florian Tenebay finished with 11 points. The Hawks (8-16, 4-3) were led by Jaden Cooper, who recorded 19 points. Zion Obanla added 10 points and four assists for Maryland-Eastern Shore. Joseph Locandro and Dorion Staples had seven points apiece. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
